entities.text: Sajal Karmakar @ Sajol Karmokar vs The State Of West Bengal
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1. 
The revisional application has been preferred challenging an order dated 30.08.2024 passed by the
learned Judge, Exclusive Pocso Court, Asansol in connection with Pocso Case No. 59 of 2017
corresponding to Special Sessions Case No.49 / 2014 arising out of Kulti P.S. Case No. 203 / 2014
dated 26.06.2014, pending before the Court of the learned Judge, Special (Pocso Act) Court,
Asansol under Sections 376 / 506 of the Indian Penal Code , 1860 and Sections 4 / 6 of the
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2.  Considering the nature of relief as prayed for, the revision is required to be heard in presence of the opposite parties.
3. The petitioner to serve upon the opposite parties.
Affidavit of service be filed before the Regular Bench.
4. Liberty to pray for stay after completion of service.

[ Shampa Dutt (Paul), J. ]
